title: Name sign at the tower door
where: north face of tower, wall cell above the door lintel at x=9,y=7,z=5 (stone-brick band, facing north)
instruction: B.sign('spruce', ['POINT','KEEPER'], {facing:'north', color:'black'}) hung on the wall at (9,7,5); if the stair lintel is in the way use signboard(g,'POINT KEEPER',{at:[8,7,5],face:'north',mode:'wall',width:3}).

title: Cottage hanging sign
where: cottage front, left of the door, x=3..4,y=7,z=2 (under the awning)
instruction: signboard(g,"KEEPER'S COTTAGE",{at:[3,6,2],face:'north',mode:'hanging',wood:'spruce'}) - a blade sign on a fence arm; text exactly KEEPER'S / COTTAGE on two lines.

title: Signal pennant on the gallery
where: gallery rail, north fence post at x=9,y=21,z=4 (beside the lantern)
instruction: B.banner('red',[['stripe_center','white'],['border','white']],{wall:false,rotation:8}) standing on the fence post at (9,21,4); add a second on the south post (9,21,14) with rotation:0.

title: Door banners on the cottage porch
where: cottage porch posts, x=5 and x=1, y=6, z=1 (hang from the awning stairs)
instruction: two wall banners facing north: B.banner('white',[['stripe_bottom','red'],['stripe_top','red']],{facing:'north'}) at (5,5,2) and (1,5,2) on the plaster beside the shutters.

title: Lantern room mullion grid
where: lantern room, y=20..22, ring radius 2 around (9,*,9)
instruction: mcd paint rule: `all faces where glass -> mullions iron_bars every 2 h`, or in build.mjs replace the middle glass layer (y=21) of each 3-wide side with iron_bars so the cage reads as a grid; keep the glowstone lamp.

title: Stripe-edge relief on the tower
instruction: Add a 1-block proud ring of white/red stairs (B.stairs('stone_brick','<facing>','top')) at the band boundary y=12 only (one string course, no more); weather the plinth ring with `all faces rows 4-5 where stone_bricks -> weather moderate`.

title: Rock base moss and shrubs
where: rock ledges around the base, x=0..3 and x=11..14, y=1..3
instruction: Add vines on the cobble faces (vine blocks, facing outward), 6 azalea / flowering_azalea bushes on the moss ledges, 4 short_grass/fern tufts and sweet_berry_bush at the stair foot; keep out of the stair flight x=4..6,z=2..4 (check mirrored coords: stairs are at x=8..10).

title: Chimney cap and smoke
instruction: Raise the 2x2 stone-brick chimney 1 block, add stone_brick_slab cap (top) and a campfire (lit=true, smoky) on a 1x1 flue, or edit roof() chimneys to size:1 with rise:3 so it gets the smoking campfire.

title: Cottage roof verge and ridge
instruction: mcd roof spec change: ridge:'wall' or ridge:'crest' (iron bars) on the cottage roof, and darken the verge with verge:'deepslate_tile' already set - add trim:'dark_oak' on the eave cornice; re-render to confirm the roof reads red tile, not salmon (try material 'red_nether_brick' with trim 'brick').

title: Fix 3 orphan verge stairs
instruction: mcd check lists brick_stairs sticking out sideways at these cells: delete them (g.set(...,'air')) or add a brick_stairs course beside each so they join the eave line.
